subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Grandeur
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Magnificence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Grandeur'** typically means the quality of being grand or magnificent. (भव्यता).

 
 
• **Example:** The grandeur of the royal palace left all the visitors in awe.
 
 
 
• The synonym** 'Magnificence'** signifies the quality of being impressively beautiful or grand.(अति उत्कृष्टता).
 
 
• **Example:** The magnificence of the natural landscapes is truly breathtaking.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is** 'Magnificence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Liable' **as per Option 2 is an adjective that means responsible by law or likely to do or to be something.(उत्तरदायी).
 
• **'Commotion'** as per Option 3 is a noun that suggests a state of confused and noisy disturbance.(हलचल).
 
• **'Power' **as per Option 4 typically refers to the ability to do something or act in a particular way, or the capacity to influence the behavior of others.(शक्ति).
